name: Breadcrumb
purpose: The path to the current page in deep hierarchies.
description: Breadcrumb trail; last segment is Current.
alternative: Render an ordered list of links inside `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">`, styled with `--color-text-tertiary` links and a `--color-text-primary` current item.

do: Show the full path from the top level.
Make every item except the last a link; the last item is the current page.
Collapse middle items into “…” when the path is long.
forbidden: Never use breadcrumbs in single-level apps.
Never repeat the page title in the same row.
Never let a breadcrumb wrap to two lines.
